current_distribution_scope: closed photography and technology group; single stable line signed with the project's long-term key; no self-imposed release gates

gradle_modules.app: Android UI, import/export orchestration, RAW/HEIF pipeline, native bridges and packaged assets
gradle_modules.core: platform-independent film, RAW, grain, color management and post-processing algorithms; product data in core/local-data
gradle_modules.android-adapter: Android Bitmap, metadata and platform image adapters with instrumentation tests
gradle_modules.glass-catalog: Backdrop/LiquidGlass UI components and upstream provenance
